title: SynMulti: Synthetic-to-Real Learning for Multimodal Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2604.12335v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for video understanding requires large-scale annotated data spanning diverse tasks such as object counting, question answering, and segmentation. However, collecting and annotating multimodal video data in real-world is costly, slow, and inherently limited in diversity and coverage. To address this challenge, we propose~\textbf{SynMulti} dataset, along with a unified synthetic data generation pipeline capable of automatically producing unlimited multimodal video data with rich and diverse supervision. Our framework supports multiple task formats within a single pipeline, enabling scalable and consistent data creation across tasks. To further enhance reasoning ability, we introduce a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy that trains models to answer structured questions about visual content rather than relying solely on captions or simple instructions. translated_title: SynMulti：面向多模态视频理解的合成到真实学习
translated_abstract: 训练用于视频理解的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）需要大规模标注数据，涵盖物体计数、问答和分割等多种任务。然而，在真实世界中收集和标注多模态视频数据成本高昂、速度缓慢，且在多样性和覆盖面上存在固有限制。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SynMulti数据集，以及一个统一的合成数据生成流水线，能够自动生成无限量的具有丰富且多样监督信号的多模态视频数据。我们的框架在单一流水线中支持多种任务格式，实现了跨任务的可扩展且一致的数据创建。为了进一步增强推理能力，我们引入了一种基于VQA的微调策略，训练模型回答关于视觉内容的结构化问题，而不是仅依赖字幕或简单指令。这种表述方式能够鼓励模型进行更深层次的推理。
tldr: 提出了SynMulti数据集及统一的合成数据生成流水线，可自动生成无限量、带丰富监督信号的多模态视频数据，并结合基于VQA的微调策略提升多模态大语言模型的视频理解与推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes SynMulti, a dataset with a unified synthetic data generation pipeline that automatically produces unlimited multimodal video data with rich supervision, combined with a VQA-based fine-tuning strategy to enhance video understanding and reasoning in multimodal large language models.
